_doc: Chức Hà Các signature items (rules-proposals R7; design/items record). Prefix chc-. Unpriced proposals; modifier sizes follow the wood and fire catalogues' grade 2-3 items (the head is Trúc Cơ).

items.name: Red Cloud Shuttle (Xích Hà Toa)

effects.name: The Thread Catches (Ti Nhiên)
effects.rule: When a foe is bound by two of the holder's threads at once, both threads catch fire: 2 Fire stacks and a short burn.

items.lore: A long needle-shuttle of red sandalwood tipped with bronze, which Thân Vân Cẩm has woven every bolt of the pavilion's fire-silk with since 1150. She named it for the Xích Hà Kỳ, the banner she means one day to equal.
items.build_use: The head's weaving weapon: burning threads and longer Fire stacks.

items.name: Robe of the First Weave (Sơ Chức Bào)

effects.name: Chars in a Season (Quý Tẫn)
effects.rule: The robe must be rewoven each season; unrewoven, its modifiers fall by a quarter each season until it is ash.

items.lore: The first fire-silk robe woven without the vents, in 1150, from Tang Điền's worms and Thân Vân Cẩm's own Fire. Tang Mộng Kiển has rewoven it two hundred times since, a thread at a time, so that it has never quite been ash.
items.build_use: The worm-keeper's robe: Fire resistance and a mending body.

items.name: Season-Woven Robe (Quý Chức Bào)
items.lore: Her own robe of vent-less fire-silk, rewoven every season when the last one chars. This is the two hundredth.
items.build_use: Binding threads, and a robe that does not burn in its own fire.

sets.name: The Unbroken Thread (Bất Đoạn Ti)

bonuses.effect: Fire Runs the Thread (Hỏa Tẩu Ti): while a foe is bound by your thread, each Wood stack on them also burns as a Burn batch. When the binding ends, the fire leaps back along the thread and lays one Burn batch for every three Wood stacks it held.

sets.story: The shuttle and the robe it wove. She wears both. The set will be whole for a season at a time, until she weaves silk that lasts.
